title: Just Juice Strawberry & Curuba 100ml Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Just Juice's Strawberry & Curuba e-liquid is a harmonious combination that will tantalize your taste buds. The succulent strawberries deliver a burst of sweetness, while the exotic curuba adds a tropical twist with its tangy and creamy flavour. With each inhale, you'll experience the vibrant and juicy notes of strawberries, followed by the unique allure of curuba. Treat yourself to this fruity symphony and let the strawberry and curuba duo take you on a mouth-watering journey of flavour. Shortfill bottles from Just Juice E-liquids provide the ideal way to personalize your nicotine levels to your exact preference. Each bottle comes with 100ml of nicotine-free e-liquid and an additional 20ml of space for two nicotine shots, giving you complete control over your vaping experience. To create 120ml of 3mg e-liquid, simply add 2 x 10ml 18mg nicotine shots to a 100ml shortfill, give it a good shake, and voila, you have your perfect mix. Shortfills not only offer extended longevity from your favourite e-liquid flavours but also serve as an economical and convenient option. Thanks to their higher VG content, they're the perfect match for high-powered, sub-ohm vape kits and low-resistance coils, ensuring maximum flavour and vapour production. Make your vaping more efficient and enjoyable by stocking up on your preferred e-liquids in shortfills. With blends tailor-made to light up your tastebuds, UK E-liquid legends Just Juice create the tangiest, tastiest, fruitiest flavours around. The flavours are long-lasting, less allergenic and easier on the throat than many alternative e-liquids and come in 50/50, Nicotine Salt and shortfills.
